section.title: AI Design Solution for Local Business FAQ

items.question: Is this only for restaurants?
items.answer: No. Restaurants, salons, retail, services, and local real estate use the same local-business storyline.

items.question: Can I get print-ready files?
items.answer: Yes. Export sizes suitable for flyers, posters, menus, and signage — plus social crops.

items.question: Do I need design skills?
items.answer: No. Describe your special, hours, or service in plain language; Brand Kit handles visual consistency.

items.question: How fast can I update a daily special?
items.answer: Most owners generate and post within minutes using Touch Edit for price or item changes.

items.question: Multiple locations?
items.answer: Brand Kit supports shared identity with per-location offer and hours customization.

items.question: Commercial usage?
items.answer: Paid plans include commercial rights for marketing assets you create for your business.
